title: Theme Hospital
provenance: Reported by chickjiew (highball-db#1246, 2026-11-15), Apple M4, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 1 minute: a 60 fps cap. The report gives no Steam id, taken to be the Steam release (2229820). Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Bullfrog's 1997 hospital game, on Steam since November 2026. Reported perfect on a base M4 with DXMT on the default engine (r28) and a 60 fps cap in a 1 minute session, so it covers the start only. Taken to be the Steam release.
